name: The Greatwolf Race Course
description: This annual event is celebrated by the Spiked Bones clan, where their best riders compete to test their agility, speed, and endurance. Other clans, or even individuals of any species, are also welcome to take on the challenge. Mounted on a Dire Wolf, it starts on the Cave of Sacrifice and ends on the Stormgrounds, covering almost all Tsvetan. It is more than a race; many perils are on the way, such as natural hazards, attacks from wild beasts, sabotage from rival competitors and clans, among other challenges The prize is a special paint from the First Red Mother’s creations, heavily guarded by the clan. It can fully protect for a single day from any penumbral effects and give resistance to all damage taken by penumbral creatures.
